notes.title: PLAYTEST BEYONDER ON MARCH 7 ON OUR DISCORD
notes.content:
[b]FROM: [/b]Site Director ████████, Pine Grove Complex
[b]RE:[/b] Scheduled Field Testing Exercise

ATTENTION ALL PERSONNEL,

The Administration has authorized a voluntary BEYONDER FIELD TESTING EXERCISE for Friday, March 7 to evaluate containment response protocols following the reports of ██████ ███ events.

All field personnel are hereby instructed to [b][url=https://discord.gg/qyMCbGHuHK]REGISTER WITH DISCORD COMMAND CENTER[/url][/b] to receive secure briefings and assignment to testing groups for the March 7 exercise.

[code]
[b]OPERATIONAL BRIEFING:[/b]

[olist]
[*] All volunteers will receive [b]immediate clearance[/b] to access the BEYONDER program
[*] Testing exercises are scheduled for [b]Friday, March 7[/b] and expected to run 2-3 hours
[*] Field agents will be granted access to [b]direct communication channel [/b] with the Administration
[*] Your field observations will be directly incorporated into future containment protocols
[/olist]

[/code]

This testing exercise represents an opportunity to shape BEYONDER operational framework and future containment doctrine.

Activate surveillance alert function by clicking [b]WISHLIST[/b] to maintain readiness for future deployments:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3160490/BEYONDER/

Non-compliance will result in immediate reassignment to ██████ or other administrative consequences.

[b]REMAIN VIGILANT.[/b]
[b]– THE ADMINISTRATION[/b]
